From bae69bfa3a586493469078ec4ca35499b754ba5c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kevin Hilman <khilman@baylibre.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2020 11:09:30 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] clk: meson: Kconfig: fix dependency for G12A

When building only G12A, ensure that VID_PLL_DIV clock driver is
selected, otherwise results in this build error:

ERROR: modpost: "meson_vid_pll_div_ro_ops" [drivers/clk/meson/g12a.ko] undefined!

Fixes: 085a4ea93d54 ("clk: meson: g12a: add peripheral clock controller")
Signed-off-by: Kevin Hilman <khilman@baylibre.com>
Signed-off-by: Jerome Brunet <jbrunet@baylibre.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20201118190930.34352-1-khilman@baylibre.com

diff --git a/drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig b/drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig
index 034da203e8e0..9a8a548d839d 100644
--- a/drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig
@@ -110,6 +110,7 @@ config COMMON_CLK_G12A
 	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_AO_CLKC
 	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_EE_CLKC
 	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_CPU_DYNDIV
+	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV
 	select MFD_SYSCON
 	help
 	  Support for the clock controller on Amlogic S905D2, S905X2 and S905Y2
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig`**
   - A new line was added to the configuration for `COMMON_CLK_G12A`:
     ```plaintext
     + select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV
     ```
   - This modification ensures that the `VID_PLL_DIV` clock driver is selected when building for the G12A configuration.

### Relationships

- The modification addresses a build error that occurs when the `VID_PLL_DIV` clock driver is not selected while building only for G12A. The error message indicates that the `meson_vid_pll_div_ro_ops` symbol is undefined, which is resolved by explicitly selecting the `COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV` in the Kconfig file. This change is linked to a previous commit that added the peripheral clock controller for G12A, indicating that the dependency on the `VID_PLL_DIV` driver was overlooked in that earlier implementation.

Here is the commit message:
clk: meson: Kconfig: fix dependency for G12A

When building only G12A, ensure that VID_PLL_DIV clock driver is
selected, otherwise results in this build error:

ERROR: modpost: "meson_vid_pll_div_ro_ops" [drivers/clk/meson/g12a.ko] undefined!

Fixes: 085a4ea93d54 ("clk: meson: g12a: add peripheral clock controller")
Signed-off-by: Kevin Hilman <khilman@baylibre.com>
Signed-off-by: Jerome Brunet <jbrunet@baylibre.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20201118190930.34352-1-khilman@baylibre.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the omission of the selection for the `COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV` clock driver in the Kconfig for `COMMON_CLK_G12A`, which led to undefined references during the build process when attempting to use the G12A configuration without this clock support.

Here is the patch:

 	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_CPU_DYNDIV
+	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV
 	select MFD_SYSCON
 	help

```c

```
```c
ERROR: modpost: "meson_vid_pll_div_ro_ops" [drivers/clk/meson/g12a.ko] undefined!
```
Reason:
The omission of the selection for the `COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV` clock driver in the Kconfig for `COMMON_CLK_G12A` means that when building the G12A configuration, the necessary clock driver is not included, leading to undefined references during the build process.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
+	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV
```
Reason:
By adding the line `select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV`, the Kconfig now ensures that the VID_PLL_DIV clock driver is selected when building for G12A, thus resolving the undefined reference issue during the build process.
